author: Crockser
quote: This is how F2P games should be, you can farm everything, you can buy anything buy trading for plat, playable items are all farmable they're not blocked by some paywall, you have the option to pay money or not, it's up to you, no pay to win, even if you pay you still need to farm to be good. Probably the best character movement in all games, a vast amount of weapons and customization, ever expanding lore. This game has it all, why not wait 12 hours to get a gun, it's not like you can't do other things while waiting.

quote:
I'm not a visual novel fan but I decided to try this game only cause it's a Digimon game with the objective of not reading anything of the story like I do on almost all the games I play, but I have to say it's a really good game, and the story became more interesting as the game advanced, it's worth a try. The people hating it only cause it's a visual novel and there's probably frustrated pokemon fans there that hate this franchise, I don't care what people thinks about a game and no one have to, just try the game and if you like it good for you and if you don't then just play another one.

But hating a game only for it's genre and your lack of information, even if the developers have been saying it was going to be a visual novel it's just pathetic, people like this should just go to the toxic community of the only game they probably play and shut up.
